description: This file defines and exports the entry point for a Telegram channel plugin within a larger plugin framework. It imports core functions and plugin-specific modules, then exports a default plugin configuration object that includes plugin metadata and references to plugin implementations.

methods.name: defineChannelPluginEntry
methods.description: Function used to define a plugin entry point with provided configuration.

calls: defineChannelPluginEntry({ id: "telegram", name: "Telegram", description: "Telegram channel plugin", plugin: telegramPlugin, setRuntime: setTelegramRuntime })
